76786.subject: Hook summer
76786.body:
View this post on the web at https://uniswap.substack.com/p/hook-summer

this week: top token launches, in one tab ∞ a simple way to earn ∞ an open standard for permissioned asset trading ∞ a security framework for hooks 
Community news
All your favorite launchpads are here: More than 340K new tokens launched into Uniswap across Robinhood Chain launchpads in July alone, generating $3.6B in trading volume. Launches (beta) [ https://substack.com/redirect/0a07fc69-d8ec-49cf-bd38-d0770123a9e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is a new tab in the Uniswap Web App that aggregates top Uniswap token launches. It’s designed to boost distribution for builders, while making discovery simple. Sign up here [ https://substack.com/redirect/6fba9b1e-749a-43f0-8b3d-507145f13095?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] if you’re interested in being featured.
Put your assets to work: Earn [ https://substack.com/redirect/c9754e49-506d-428c-b251-f5f657569d62?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is out now in the Uniswap Web App [ https://substack.com/redirect/f0acbf24-d0b2-43a1-b9b7-24364cbcd87e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] and Wallet [ https://substack.com/redirect/cc50149d-9a03-4886-9f4e-fb34c87d0dce?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. It’s built for anyone holding assets who wants a simple way to earn on them. Deposit in a few taps, watch your balance grow over time, and withdraw whenever you want.
Start building with DualPool: Designed in collaboration with Spark, the new open source hook lets market makers earn lending yield on their inventory until the moment a swap needs it. Learn more  [ https://substack.com/redirect/4ed208bc-77d9-4ad9-96a4-ba3e4f03583d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]about how it works, and deploy a DualPool of your own [ https://substack.com/redirect/65e408f8-57cb-4858-97ad-d40a8a2b0523?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ].
An open source standard for permissioned assets: The tokenized asset market is estimated to reach $11 trillion [ https://substack.com/redirect/6a2eca6d-b6c1-499f-a5e1-c557c4e9598b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] by 2030. As more regulated assets come onchain, they need market infrastructure that fits them. Permissioned Pools [ https://substack.com/redirect/609db202-77c7-4688-a4b1-8582b3a13266?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] enable permissioned asset trading through AMMs, with compliance enforced directly onchain.
A security guide for v4 teams: Hooks unlock new capabilities: dynamic fees, custom accounting, and external integrations. But these features introduce security risks that differ from traditional smart contracts. To help teams design safer systems, Trail of Bits created a guide with patterns and best practices

76784.subject: Crypto Misses the Rally That Closed July
76784.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These were the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto today:

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-lags-stock-rally-after-hawkish-fed-hold)**[ lags a stock rally as July closes](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-lags-stock-rally-after-hawkish-fed-hold)

* **[Metronome](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/metronome-discloses-usd15-7-million-synth-shortfall-blames-oracle-lag-in-swap-module)**[ discloses a $15.7M unbacked synth gap](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/metronome-discloses-usd15-7-million-synth-shortfall-blames-oracle-lag-in-swap-module)

* **[Coinbase](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/coinbase-says-revenue-from-its-base-layer-2-fell-despite-record-volume)**[ earns less from Base despite record volume](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/coinbase-says-revenue-from-its-base-layer-2-fell-despite-record-volume)

* **[YGG Play](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/ygg-play-shuts-down-services-as-yield-guild-pivots-to-ai-data)**[ goes dark as Yield Guild turns to AI data](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/ygg-play-shuts-down-services-as-yield-guild-pivots-to-ai-data)

* **[Polygon](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/polygon-turns-kansai-electric-loyalty-points-into-jpyc-spending)**[ turns Kansai Electric points into yen stablecoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/polygon-turns-kansai-electric-loyalty-points-into-jpyc-spending)

Stocks closed July with a 1.7% Friday rally. Bitcoin spent the same session down 3.5%.

[Bitcoin traded at $62,464 while the Nasdaq gained 2.8%](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-lags-stock-rally-after-hawkish-fed-hold), and total crypto market capitalization slipped 2.3% to $2.24 trillion. June PCE inflation printed at 3.7% year-over-year on Thursday, a day after the Fed's fifth straight hold and Chair **Kevin Warsh**'s warning that "this Fed will not waver."

Bitcoin still finished July up 4.3% off a sub-$58,000 start, and the CoinDesk 20 posted its first green month in three. Options desks are hedging anyway. After Friday's $10 billion Deribit expiry, the largest open interest sits in the $60,000 put at $1.17 billion notional, displacing the $70,000 and $72,000 calls that led into the Fed meeting.

**Read more below!**

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

##### MARKETS

## Bitcoin Lags Stock Rally After Hawkish Fed Hold

Bitcoin fell 3.5% over 24 hours to $62,464 on Friday while the S&P 500 climbed 1.7% and the Nasdaq gained 2.8%, [leaving crypto out of the last rally of July](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-lags-stock-rally-after-hawkish-fed-hold). Ether dropped 3.1% to $1,863 and total market capitalization slipped 2.3% to $2.24 trillion. The Fed held at 3.50%-3.75% on Wednesday in a 9-3 vote where all three dissenters wanted a hike, the first same-direction trio since 2016.
